info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with AppLovin SDK.
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with AppLovin SDK.

elements.name: applovin.initialize
elements.description: Initialize the AppLovin SDK with the provided SDK key.

elements.name: applovin.set_callback
elements.description: Sets a callback function for receiving events from the SDK. Call `applovin.set_callback(nil)` to remove callback

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Callback function that is executed on any event in the SDK.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: One of the following types of events. "OnSdkInitializedEvent", "OnCmpCompletedEvent", "OnInterstitialAdLoadedEvent", "OnInterstitialAdLoadFailedEvent", "OnInterstitialAdDisplayedEvent", "OnInterstitialAdDisplayFailedEvent", "OnInterstitialAdHiddenEvent", "OnInterstitialAdClickedEvent", "OnInterstitialAdRevenuePaidEvent", "OnRewardedAdLoadedEvent",  "OnRewardedAdLoadFailedEvent", "OnRewardedAdDisplayedEvent", "OnRewardedAdDisplayFailedEvent", "OnRewardedAdHiddenEvent", "OnRewardedAdClickedEvent", "OnRewardedAdReceivedRewardEvent", "OnRewardedAdRevenuePaidEvent", "OnBannerAdLoadedEvent", "OnBannerAdLoadFailedEvent", "OnBannerAdClickedEvent", "OnBannerAdExpandedEvent", "OnBannerAdCollapsedEvent", "OnBannerAdRevenuePaidEvent", "OnMRecAdLoadedEvent", "OnMRecAdLoadFailedEvent", "OnMRecAdClickedEvent", "OnMRecAdExpandedEvent", "OnMRecAdCollapsedEvent", "OnMRecAdRevenuePaidEvent",

fields.name: params

elements.name: applovin.is_initialized
elements.description: Checks if the AppLovin SDK has been initialized.

returnvalues.name: is_initialized
returnvalues.doc: Returns true if the SDK is initialized, false otherwise.

elements.description: Sets whether the user has provided consent for interest-based advertising.

elements.name: applovin.is_age_restricted_user

elements.name: applovin.is_do_not_sell

elements.name: applovin.is_tablet

elements.name: applovin.set_user_id
elements.description: Set internal user ID before initializing the SDK.

elements.description: Sets whether ads from certain mediated SDK networks should be muted.
